ci_description: Governed CI path: validates a clean copy of the commit with the rules of an external CI policy only, checked by the hash of its bundle (JGATES_POLICY_SHA256).
ci_option_cwd: Checkout to validate (default: the current folder). It must be a Git repository.
ci_option_policy: CI policy folder (jgates.yml and .jgates/), outside the checkout. Without the option, JGATES_POLICY_DIR is used.
ci_option_head: Commit to analyze (default: HEAD), always in a clean copy in the data folder; the work tree never enters.
ci_option_base: Base reference of the changed scope.
ci_option_profile: Policy profile to use; only a profile the policy itself defines is accepted (default: the policy's default profile).
ci_option_out: Folder to copy the run artifacts to (result.json, plan.json, events and logs), for example inside the checkout for the CI to publish.
ci_option_sarif: Writes the findings as SARIF 2.1.0 to this file.
ci_option_fail_fast: Stops at the first problem; the rest is recorded as not run and the decision is never passed.
ci_option_events_jsonl: Also writes a copy of the run events (JSON Lines) to this file.
ci_option_no_interactive: Never waits for input (ci asks nothing anyway).
ci_option_bridge_mode: Only full is accepted: the governed CI always runs the bridge in its complete mode.
ci_option_refused: Refused in the governed CI: the selection comes from the policy only.
ci_bad_cwd: The checkout folder does not exist or is not a folder: {path}
ci_option_refused_error: The option {name} is not accepted by the governed CI: whoever is evaluated does not choose the rules.
ci_option_refused_error_fix: Remove {name} from the job. To change what runs, change the CI policy (and update JGATES_POLICY_SHA256).
ci_bridge_mode_refused: The governed CI does not accept --bridge-mode {value}: the bridge always runs in its complete mode.
ci_bridge_mode_refused_fix: Remove --bridge-mode from the job (or use full).
ci_scope_refused: The governed CI does not accept the scope {value}.
ci_bad_path: The folder of {name} does not exist or the path is a folder: {path}
ci_bad_path_fix: Give {name} a valid path in a folder that already exists.
ci_bad_out: {path} exists and is not a folder.
ci_bad_out_fix: Give --out a folder (it is created when missing).
ci_error_policy_dir_required: The CI policy folder is missing.
ci_error_policy_dir_required_fix: Pass --policy <folder> or set JGATES_POLICY_DIR to the folder of the policy repository.
ci_error_policy_sha256_required: JGATES_POLICY_SHA256 is missing: without a checked hash nothing runs.
ci_error_policy_sha256_required_fix: Set JGATES_POLICY_SHA256 in a protected CI variable to the hash of the policy bundle (the CI policy screen of jgates ui --policy shows it).
ci_error_policy_sha256_invalid: JGATES_POLICY_SHA256 is not a sha256 hash (64 hexadecimal characters).
ci_error_policy_sha256_invalid_fix: Copy the hash of the policy bundle without spaces (the sha256: prefix is accepted).
ci_error_policy_hash_mismatch: The hash of the policy bundle ({actual}) differs from JGATES_POLICY_SHA256 ({expected}).
ci_error_policy_hash_mismatch_fix: If the policy changed on purpose, the CI administrators update JGATES_POLICY_SHA256; otherwise, check where the policy folder came from.
ci_error_policy_dir_missing: The policy folder does not exist: {path}
ci_error_policy_dir_missing_fix: Check the path of --policy or JGATES_POLICY_DIR and the checkout of the policy repository in the job.
ci_error_policy_root_missing: The policy folder has no jgates.yml.
ci_error_policy_root_missing_fix: Point to the root of the policy repository, where jgates.yml is.
ci_error_policy_inside_project: The policy is inside the analyzed checkout ({path}): the evaluated code itself could change it.
ci_error_policy_inside_project_fix: Check the policy repository out outside the project folder.
ci_error_policy_symlink: The policy has a symbolic link in its bundle: {path}
ci_error_policy_symlink_fix: Replace the link with the real file in the policy repository.
ci_error_policy_ref_outside: The policy configuration points to a file outside the policy folder: {path}
ci_error_policy_ref_outside_fix: Keep every file the configuration names inside the policy repository.
ci_error_policy_bad_path: A policy file has a line break in its name: {path}
ci_error_policy_bad_path_fix: Rename the file in the policy repository.
ci_error_policy_unreadable: The policy file {path} could not be read.
ci_error_policy_unreadable_fix: Check the permissions of the policy repository checkout.
ci_error_policy_quality_invalid: The bridge quality policy (.jgates/quality-policy.json) is invalid: {detail}
ci_error_policy_quality_invalid_fix: Fix the file in the policy repository (JSON with schemaVersion 1, in the format of the quality gate policy).
ci_error_policy_waivers_invalid: The policy waivers (.jgates/waivers.json) could not be read: {detail}
ci_error_policy_waivers_invalid_fix: Fix the file in the policy repository.
ci_error_policy_profile_refused: The profile {profile} is not a profile defined by the policy.
ci_error_policy_profile_refused_fix: Use one of the policy profiles ({allowed}) or remove --profile to use its default profile.
ci_plan_not_approvable: The plan of the policy cannot be executed ({code}): {detail}
ci_plan_not_approvable_fix: Adjust the policy (or the job environment) and check the plan with jgates ui --policy, in Test against a project.
ci_snapshot_failed: The copy of the commit {commit} could not be written: {detail}
ci_snapshot_failed_fix: Check that the commit exists in the checkout (a shallow clone may lack --base) and that git is on the PATH.
ci_cancel_requested: Cancellation requested: stopping the processes of the running step and writing the partial result.
ci_summary_failed_incomplete: rejected: {count} blocking violations; {missing} required requirements without evidence
ci_summary_reduced: incomplete: the selection was reduced and the governed CI never approves a reduced selection
ci_error_policy_budgets_weakened: The bridge quality policy turns off or loosens a mandatory budget: {detail}
ci_error_policy_budgets_weakened_fix: In jgates ci the budgets are mandatory: remove budgets.enabled: false and keep every budget between 1 and the ceiling of the standard profile.
ci_error_policy_budgets_disabled: The policy turns off the file size check (the budgets of the quality gate), which jgates ci requires.
ci_error_policy_budgets_disabled_fix: Turn capability:file-size (or tool:quality-bridge.file-size) back on in the policy's profile.
ci_error_ci_submodule_refused: The commit has a submodule (gitlink) at {path}: its files belong to another repository and would not be analyzed.
ci_error_ci_submodule_refused_fix: Remove the submodule from the analyzed commit, or analyze its repository in a job of its own.
ci_error_ci_symlink_escape: The symbolic link {path} of the commit resolves outside the checkout: a tool would read files of the CI machine through it.
ci_error_ci_symlink_escape_fix: Point the link at a file inside the repository, or remove it from the commit.
ci_error_ci_tree_unreadable: The tree of the analyzed commit could not be read ({path}): {detail}
ci_error_ci_tree_unreadable_fix: Check that the checkout is a Git work tree with the commit and that git is on the PATH.
